# job_boards

The actions your AI can run on job_boards through DozalDevs. They are the same tools a Dozal uses, run the same way. Run one with `run_app_action` (MCP) or the run-app-action command, app `job_boards` and the action's slug below; `get_app_action` shows its inputs. A Viewer key runs only the actions that read.

| Action                 | Reads or changes | What it does                                                                |
| ---------------------- | ---------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GET_APPLICATION_FORM` | reads            | List the fields a job's online application asks for, and which are required |
| `LIST_POSTINGS`        | reads            | List open roles from companies' public job boards in one shared shape       |
